project_spec.name: Tsugi (次)
project_spec.overview: Tsugi (次) is a fast, edge-ready anime and manga app for building and sharing curated lists. A signed-in user creates a named, categorised list of titles — searched from a provider or imported from their own AniList/MAL library — scores and comments them, and publishes a shareable link with a rich social preview. Anyone can open that link; only creating needs an account (D23). Published lists also appear on a public, vote-ranked feed at `/feed` (D43).

core_mission.principle: Zero-friction creation: landing to link-on-clipboard in under 10 seconds.
Instant sharing: auto-copied share link with one-click X / Discord / WhatsApp buttons.
Rich previews: every `/r/[slug]` link renders a 1200x630 social card via `next/og`.
Public discovery: `/feed` ranks published lists by live upvote/downvote score, filterable by category.

product_shape.entity: Slug-addressed, user-owned, named (category, e.g. "Romance"), optional caption + comment (≤280), draft or published, view-counted.
Ordered by explicit `position`. Identified by the triple `(provider, mediaType, externalId)`. Optional score and optional ≤280-char comment.
One vote per user per list; drives feed ranking. Rate-limited per user.
Per-user cached tracker-library fetch. Cache-once-then-explicit-refresh (`?refresh=1`), with stale fallback on provider failure.
Better-Auth user plus `username` (defaulted at signup, editable in Settings) and `scoreFormat` (D32).
product_shape.excluded: No comments/replies, no following, no per-user profile pages, no editing history, no analytics (see `functionality.md`).

tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 (CSS-configured — there is NO `tailwind.config.ts`) + shadcn/ui on Radix (D41). Custom "Eyecatch" palette authored once in `src/app/globals.css`.

database.provider: Supabase PostgreSQL 17.6, `ap-southeast-2`, Transaction Pooler (`prepare: false`, D8)
database.orm: Drizzle ORM 0.45.2 / drizzle-kit 0.31.10 — migrations only, never DDL via MCP (D19)
database.security: RLS enabled on every table, from the first migration (D20)

tech_stack.authentication: Better-Auth 1.6.26 mounted inside Hono (D6). `genericOAuth` for AniList and MAL (MAL needs custom PKCE token exchange, D30). GitHub OAuth was never built.

data_providers.tier2: MyAnimeList — Jikan REST v4 and official MAL API v2, both id space `mal`
data_providers.note: No cross-provider fallback: the id spaces are disjoint (D15, D29).

infrastructure.hosting: Vercel — `https://tsugi-lyart.vercel.app`. Node runtime everywhere the DB is touched (D21).
infrastructure.rate_limiting: Upstash Redis `fit-hyena-107044.upstash.io` (`@upstash/ratelimit` 2.0.8). Create limiter keys on the user, not the IP (D34).

tech_stack.other: nanoid 6 (12-char slugs, collision retry, D11), cmdk 1.1.1 (combobox, D42), lucide-react, class-variance-authority, tailwind-merge

api_surface.route: Create a list (Zod-validated, user-keyed rate limit)
Import the user's tracker library (cached; `?refresh=1` forces re-fetch)
Category discovery for the filter chips

current_state.phase: Public page & OG cards — 22/25, deployed to Vercel
List import — code complete and unit-tested; criteria 1–8 need a real linked account, criterion 12 needs a live stopwatch pass
Dashboard — `/dashboard`, list CRUD, provider unlink with last-provider guard

The custom-lists pivot (D43) — feed, voting, categories, usernames, ListBuilder two-column layout — shipped ahead of a written phase spec. `PLAN.md`'s phase map still ends at 8; a PHASE-9 spec is the outstanding planning debt.
current_state.blocked_on: Live browser/OAuth verification by a human (Phase 7 criteria 1–8 and 12, Phase 8 criteria 2/4/12/13, Phase 6 criterion 13's real Discord/X unfurl). No code is blocked.

project_spec.working_rules: Read `AGENTS.md` first — it holds the 15 invariants, the process/code/UI rules, and the session workflow, and they override anything summarised here. In particular: slugs are the only public identifier; media identity is `(provider, mediaType, externalId)`; the ORM never leaves the server; every visual value is a shadcn semantic token; a score is a `(raw, format)` pair and `0` means unrated; provider tokens never reach the client; and every phase ends with `context/` updated.
